notes: Regression probes remain hypothetical 2-in squares, not official toy-car shapes or legal three-obstacle arrangements.
Board-reference grid origins are independent of wall inset. Geometry-derived passage midpoints supplement both grids.
Race task staging and ordered gates are retained. Only pit-entry/docking/withdrawal construction waypoints are freed in selectable modes.
North pit access is an explicitly alternative engineering corridor around the far end of the pit divider, not permission to enter there.
Fixed start, docking pose and final race staging are preserved; selectable approaches must both arrive and leave.
One origin is used for expensive full-route comparisons; both origins are compared on the failed upper leg without geometry supplements first.
